main_body: Round wooden conductor's podium: a wide disc top with a drum-shaped front face, and a music stand with a sheet panel on top
top_band: Large tan elliptical disc, rows ~12-25 in the middle column, with a lighter highlight rim along the front edge at rows ~25-26
evidence: The middle column starts at the stand's dark pole, then runs through a big tan top ellipse about 12 rows tall. A lighter front-edge row follows, then a darker brown front face of about 5 rows (rows ~27-31) with a dark base line. The top is clearly a horizontal surface seen from above, above a distinct vertical front, so it reads as 3/4. The front face is plain with no inset or shadow band, but the top is large enough to carry the view.

style.evidence: The outline is dark brown, tinted to match the wood, which is good. The tan top is a huge near-flat fill with only a few highlight pixels at the left and right edges, and it has no grain, plank lines or speckle. The front face is a flat brown block with a darker corner patch. The stand and sheet are simple. Next to the reference stall and well, which carry per-tile texture and 5-6 tone ramps, this has about 3-4 tones per material and many tiles of only 2-4 colours, so it looks thinner and flatter.
